keep_apart.why: USER RULING 2026-10-25 (from the deck owner): 'I talked with the deck owner and he thinks that 10 buckets is fine. Untapped Filters, untapped colourless, Blue sources, Green sources, both, neither, skerry, galadriel, sol ring and crackle.' On red: 'Red seemed sensible, but thinking more about it this hardly ever matters or changes your mulligan decisions. Since it is very easy to get red when going off.' So the Temples are classed by blue/green only. FINAL CHOICE K=9, the USER delegating it: 'The most relevant part of the untapped land is actually playing the turn you crackle for one more mana, so it is pretty low-relevance and somewhat comparable to having Red. (which can also be generated at the cost of 1 mana from a filter land) So yeah, I can see the argument to merge. I seem to be almost convincing myself of K=9... So you can use whichever you think appropriate.' The agent chose K=9: red is already ignored on the same grounds, and K=9 is exactly the shipped table's bucketing. PINS K=9: each keep_apart group takes ONE card from each of the nine buckets (a group vetoes every pair inside it), and the 14 groups together cover every cross-bucket pair, so no two buckets can merge or chain through a third card.
